summary: Through road kerb through bush: no parked cars, no verge, steep.
reasons: Bush right to the road edge

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush to the east; homes 12 m or more away at the start only, none beyond 70 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with trees and bank against the edge; no clear verge or pull-off wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Through route linking suburbs, with power lines along the road.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb and no marked parking lane.

flags: Mapped gate near the start, a route runs around it
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tree canopy from the east and west.
